> what happened?

Other than "infinite" or "indeterminate" effects (like Crimson
Sentinel, and like Ecstatic Agony), this is how I come up with dealing
20 points of damage in a single non-combat-card strike:

The acting minion is Jack, the Blood Brother. He has +1 strength.
His controller also controls a Ventrue, and has played an Island of
Yiaros. Jack is made Regent (4 votes => +4 strength)

Jack has been given PRO (and maybe SER).
There is a superior Mark of Damnation on Basil (for a total of +3
strength in combat vs poor Basil).
Jack has Clan Impersonated to !Toreador, been given the Art of Pain (+2),
and then burned the Clan Impersonation.
Depravity is played on Jack (+1).
Jack equips with Bang Nakh (+2).

Jack enters combat with Basil using Coagulated Entity, taking from each
of the other Blood Brothers (+4). He plays Uncontrollable Rage at superior,
for +2 (aggravated) hand damage during this action.

1+1+4+3+2+1+2+4+2 = a strike for 20 (2 of it being agg), with the Bang Nakh.
And oh, does Basil burn.

Is that what you were going for?
(it's 19 when Basil isn't involved, of course)

> Jack equips with Bang Nakh (+2).
> Jack enters combat with Basil using Coagulated Entity, taking from each
> of the other Blood Brothers (+4). He plays Uncontrollable Rage at superior,
> for +2 (aggravated) hand damage during this action.

The aggravated damage portion only effects strikes made with his
hands.
If Jack strikes with the Bang Nakh, none of the damage will be
aggravated.

Uncontrollable Rage modifies the damage that the vampire inflicts with
a hand strike. It doesn't modify the vampire's base strength. So, if
the vampire strikes with Scorpion Sting, he inflicts 1 (base) + 2 agg
(Rage) + 1 (Scorpion) damage, for a total of 2 + 2 agg damage. If the
vampire strikes with a Bastard Sword, he inflicts only 1 (base) +1
(Sword) damage, for a total of 2 damage (the Rage doesn't modify the
damage, since it is not a hand strike).
[LSJ 19980102]

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

For example, it doesn't rule out help from other players (Frenzy),
intervention from other vamps you control (Save Face), or cards played
by the opposing vampire (trap, undead persistence).

My suggestions:

** Ambrosius gets a Meat Hook. Rush. Opposing Vampire plays Undead
Persistence. Fight for 32 rounds.

** Ex Nihilo vamp (with meat hook), rushes Ambrosius and plays
superior Weather Control. Combat continues for an infinite number of
rounds. The game times out, with both combatants taking (and ignoring)
infinite damage each round.

** Every player in the game has a stupid number of Freak Drives and
Wolf Companions in their deck. On turn 5, Angus the Windswept plays
Shepherds Innocence, gaining control of 30 wolves. Rush. Fight for 1
round.

** Crimson Sentinel, rush, Taste of Vitae and Freak drive. A lot.

** Richter rushes a famous Raven, Burning Wrath + pulled fangs, freak
drive, rescue. Lazverinus rushes again.

Raven plays Trap, inf. Drawing out the Beast, and then Undead
Persistence a couple of times. Laz plays nothing. Fight for 8 rounds.

is now too low for Freak Drive + rescue).

This is beginning to feel a lot like some of my college classes when the
professor is "fishing" for a particular answer. He asks a question and a dozen
people answer with valid answers that are synonyms of his "special word" but
none is exactly that "special word." I've always hated classes like that when
all the questions are so leading. People can think for themselves, you know?

Similarly, perhaps Mr. McBathan would like to spend a little more time thinking
about his question before posting it, along with who knows how many addendums
and other modifications. It seems quite likely that Mr. McBathan thought of a
way to do a lot of damage in combat, poses a question to see if anyone can get
the *exact* solution he came up with, and wants some sort of acknowledgment
about how clever he is.

Let's take a look at his "new criteria":

>he vamp is independent.

LSJ already covered this one about CI'ing at the very end.

>you control only one of
>each given card

Many minion cards won't actually be controlled by you. You can still play 10
Political Struggles or 15 Mark of Damnations because as long as they are on a
vampire you don't control, they are controlled by the controller of the
respective vampire.

In addition, you can still have 31 Concordances on your vampire, as long as you
control only one (give control of the others to other players via Succubus
Club).

>no skill cards

This still allows Sanguine Instruction, Infernal Pact, Infernal Familiar, Vial
of Elder Vitae, Camarilla Vitae Slave and Ian Forestal as ways to get access to
other disciplines.

Care to try again?

Halcyan 2
